title: Light and Easy Irish Paella
description: A simplified, one-pot dish that combines the flavors of Ireland with the classic Spanish paella.
instructions: Heat the light olive oil in a large skillet or paella pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced Irish sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the peeled and diced potatoes to the pan and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the uncooked paella to the pan and stir to combine with the sausage and potatoes.
Cook the paella for 10-12 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, and serve hot.
Optional: Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley or thyme.
